item.description:
Non-Toxic & Safe
Safety and comfort are our top priorities, which is why our play mats are made from PVC-free, BPA-free, lead-free PU foam and free of other nasty chemicals, tested according to EN-71 and CPSIA US toy safety standards. NO chemical off-gassing. No squeaky sounds when stepped on.

2cm Thick & Padded
All GingerBubs luxe padded mats are 2cm thick, giving your baby extra comfort and protection from falls and stumbles. The elastic PU foam provides excellent shock absorption during falls, protecting little heads, hands and knees. Adult-friendly for your knees too!

Spacious enough for you and baby
Generously-sized at 200cm x 140cm - more than enough space for you to join baby on the floor for play and bonding.

Fuss-free, easy clean
Mat surface is water-resistant, spill-proof. No interwoven fibers or hidden crevices to hide food/stain residues - saving you the time and hassle when cleaning. Just wipe clean and go!
**AVOID certain food such as dragonfruit, mangosteen, curry, turmeric which may permanently stain the mat.
** Always use WASHABLE crayons and pens when used on the mat.

Lightweight and portable
As PU foam material itself is naturally lightweight, this makes cleaning the area under the mat easier. Also, portable for you to move it from room to room or bring it on the go. 

Aesthetically-pleasing, minimalist design
GingerBubs play mats are designed not just for your little ones, but made to complement your home. No compromises needed on function and style.
Say goodbye to your home looking like a kindergarten!

Durable, grows with your child
Our versatile mats are most used during infancy period for early developmental milestones - from tummy time, rolling, sitting, crawling to first steps. Use it as an activity mat for toddler stage - for tumble and play, reading. Or just a mat for the family to sit on for board games and movie night.

DIMENSIONS
Large mat 200cm x 140cm x 2cm thick
Medium mat 140cm x 100cm x 2cm thick (half of large mat size)

CARE GUIDE
>> Wipe clean immediately using a soft damp cloth or gentle wet wipes to avoid staining.
>> AVOID acidic and strong alcohol- based cleaning agents/wet wipes which may discolour mats.
>> Vigorous rubbing may damage and discolour the top layer color.
>> Avoid using sharp or hot objects on your play mat (high heels, scissors, coffee cups and vacuums, etc.
>> Prolonged exposure to direct sunlight and high temperature may accelerate discolouration of mat.
>> Use washable crayons, pen and ink only. Other pens/ink may cause permanent stain.
>> Not recommended to have pets on the mat as their teeth and claws may damage or tear mat (not covered under warranty).

**As our mats contain NO plasticisers or chemical stabilisers, mild yellowish discolouration is expected at the edges of the mat over time. This is due to the natural aging process of PU material and is normal and expected. It is not a defect and not hazardous.
